title: Scalable WebSockets Chat Architecture
learningObjectives: Scale WebSocket connection servers across a horizontal cluster using Redis Pub/Sub
Implement heartbeat pings, exponential reconnects, and message delivery receipts
keyTradeoffs: WebSockets vs Server-Sent Events (SSE) for bidirectional vs unidirectional streaming
Ephemeral in-memory message passing vs persistent database chat transcripts
commonPitfalls: Storing user socket connections on a single server without cross-server pub/sub broadcast
Failing to authenticate connection upgrades before accepting WebSocket handshakes
transferPrompt: How do you layer real-time online/offline presence tracking on top of active WebSocket connections?
